description: Source code for the TMP116 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write, EEPROM access, device ID check, sensor data fetch, attribute set/get, and device initialization.

methods.name: tmp116_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the TMP116 device via I2C.

methods.name: tmp116_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the TMP116 device via I2C.

methods.name: check_eeprom_bounds
methods.description: Checks if EEPROM access is within valid bounds.

methods.name: tmp116_eeprom_write
methods.description: Writes data to the TMP116 EEPROM.

methods.name: tmp116_eeprom_read
methods.description: Reads data from the TMP116 EEPROM.

methods.name: tmp116_device_id_check
methods.description: Verifies the device ID of the TMP116.

methods.name: tmp116_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the latest temperature sample from the sensor.

methods.name: tmp116_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sample data to sensor_value.

methods.name: tmp116_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as offset.

methods.name: tmp116_attr_get
methods.description: Gets sensor attributes such as configuration.

methods.name: tmp116_init
methods.description: Initializes the TMP116 device during driver setup.
